title: PromptRobust: Towards Evaluating the Robustness of Large Language Models on Adversarial Prompts
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating LLM robustness to adversarial prompts that mimic plausible user errors. While it mentions related work on LLM safety regarding harmful instructions and misaligned values, its own contributions are explicitly stated not to be designed to elicit or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics, but rather to assess semantic integrity under perturbation.
